definitions: A small, slender missile, typically pointed at one end and feathered at the other, thrown by hand in the game of darts.
A tapered tuck sewn into a garment to give it shape.
A small, pointed weapon or missile.
examples: He threw a dart at the board.
The rabbit made a dart for cover.
The dress had two darts at the back.
The hunter used a dart to tranquilize the animal.
